taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-05 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 26.6 | 4.30 | 4.30
2 | 119.1 | 2.37 | 6.67
3 | 340.4 | 0.77 | 7.44
4 | 640.3 | 0.77 | 8.21
5 | 2441.4 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-05
Curve type: A-type (Ascending / AAA)
Aquifer depth: 0.0 – 4.3 m (shallow overburden only)
Recommendation: High-resistivity impermeable bedrock is encountered at a shallow depth of approximately 8.2 m, indicating very poor potential for a deep production borehole. Drilling is not recommended at this location unless a shallow, large-diameter well targeting the upper 4.3 m is desired.
